title: Microsoft SQL Server
scope: A production-focused SQL Server curriculum covering T-SQL, storage engine internals, indexing, Query Store, intelligent query processing, security, backup/recovery, Availability Groups, replication, columnstore, in-memory OLTP, observability, and SQL Server 2025 capabilities.
coverage_note: SQL Server 2025 (17.x) baseline with current developer, security, HA, and AI/vector features
